explanation.headline: Mesna is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Corvale East has 22.4 days on hand and Corvale General has 15.7 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's records show mesna is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 73 vials of mesna 100 mg/mL 10 mL at 3.3 vials per day, providing 22.4 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 43 vials of the same presentation at 2.7 vials per day, providing 15.7 days on hand.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Sagent Pharmaceuticals, which is also not on FDA's shortage list today.
Sagent Pharmaceuticals' plant is listed as SAGENT PHARMS INC.
Alternative manufacturers Bamboo US Bidco LCC and Baxter Healthcare Company are not on the shortage list but their labels name no plant we could place.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
